name: Upright vacuum
definition: vacuum cleaner whose motor, dust container and powered floor head form one standing body pushed across the floor.

name: Cylinder vacuum (canister)
definition: vacuum cleaner with a body on wheels or runners pulled behind on a hose and wand.

name: Stick vacuum
definition: light vacuum cleaner with the motor and dust container on a long wand ending in a floor head.

name: Handheld vacuum
definition: small vacuum cleaner held in one hand and used without a floor wand, including car and mattress vacuums.

name: Robot vacuum
definition: self-driving vacuum cleaner that navigates the floor on its own and returns to a dock; mopping and dock functions are attributes.

name: Wet-and-dry vacuum (shop vacuum)
definition: vacuum cleaner made to pick up liquids as well as dry dirt and debris, wherever it is used.

name: Central vacuum
definition: vacuum unit installed in a building and used through hose inlets connected by fixed piping.

name: Backpack vacuum
definition: vacuum cleaner whose body is carried on the user's back on a harness.

name: Floor washer (wet-dry scrubber, 洗地机)
definition: cordless upright machine that wets the floor, scrubs it with a powered roller and sucks the dirty water back into a tank.

name: Carpet cleaning machine (carpet extractor)
definition: machine that sprays cleaning solution into carpet or upholstery and extracts it with the loosened dirt.

name: Floor scrubber
definition: machine with powered pads or brushes that scrubs hard floors with water and solution.

name: Floor polisher
definition: machine with rotating pads or brushes that polishes or buffs hard floors.

name: Dry mop (dust mop)
definition: mop with a wide dry head that collects dust from hard floors.

name: Flat mop (wet mop)
definition: mop with a flat rectangular pad on a swivel plate for wet cleaning.

name: Sponge mop
definition: mop with a sponge head, usually wrung by a lever on the handle.

name: Steam mop
definition: powered mop whose body carries a steam generator and cleans the floor with steam through a pad.

name: Spin mop
definition: mop with a round head wrung by spinning it in a basket of its bucket.

name: Cloth mop (Cuban mop)
definition: floor cloth worked over the floor with a squeegee or T-shaped stick.

name: Spray mop
definition: flat mop with a refillable tank that sprays cleaning liquid ahead of the head.

name: Robot mop
definition: self-driving floor cleaner that mops with a driven pad or roller, carries a water tank and has no suction; a robot vacuum that also mops is B6.1.1.05 (section 14, provisional).

name: Broom
definition: brush of bristles or fibres on a long handle for sweeping floors.

name: Carpet sweeper
definition: unpowered push sweeper whose rotating brushes, driven by its wheels, lift dirt from carpet into a box.

name: Dustpan
definition: flat scoop, often with a hand brush, into which sweepings are brushed.

name: Mop bucket
definition: bucket made to hold water for a mop, often with a wringer.

name: Floor and carpet cleaning product
definition: liquid, foam or powder made to clean floors and carpets.

name: Microfibre cloth
definition: cleaning cloth of fine split synthetic fibres that picks up dust and grease.

name: Chamois
definition: soft absorbent leather or leather-like cloth used to dry and polish glass and paintwork.

name: Feather duster
definition: bundle of feathers or fibres on a handle for dusting.

name: Dishcloth
definition: cloth made for washing dishes and wiping kitchen surfaces.

name: Sponge or scourer
definition: absorbent or abrasive pad used by hand to wipe and scrub surfaces and dishes.

name: Scrub brush
definition: stiff-bristled hand brush made for household scrubbing.

name: Squeegee
definition: rubber-bladed tool drawn across glass or tiles to remove water.

name: Window vacuum (Fenstersauger)
definition: handheld battery device with a squeegee blade that sucks water off windows and tiles.

name: Window-cleaning robot
definition: self-driving device that holds itself to a window and cleans the glass.

name: Steam cleaner
definition: appliance that cleans floors and hard surfaces with steam through a hose or nozzle.

name: Multi-purpose cleaner
definition: cleaning product made for most hard surfaces in the home.

name: Bleach and disinfectant
definition: product made to kill germs, bleach or sanitise surfaces.

name: Glass cleaner
definition: product made to clean glass and mirrors without streaks.

name: Toilet cleaner
definition: product made to clean and descale the toilet bowl.

name: Limescale remover
definition: product made to dissolve limescale on taps, tiles and sanitaryware.

name: Degreaser and oven cleaner
definition: product made to dissolve grease and baked-on soil on hobs, ovens and kitchen surfaces.

name: Mould remover
definition: product made to remove mould and mildew from surfaces.

name: Furniture and upholstery cleaner
definition: product made to clean or care for furniture surfaces and upholstery.

name: Shoe cleaner
definition: product made to clean shoes.

name: Shoe polish and waterproofing
definition: polish, conditioner or spray made to care for, colour or waterproof shoes (B-23, K-11(c)).

name: Car-wash shampoo
definition: product made to wash a vehicle's paintwork.

name: Descaler for kettles and machines
definition: product or tablet made to remove limescale from kettles, coffee machines and other appliances (K-11(a)).

name: Pet-stain cleaner
definition: product made to clean stains and odours left by pets.

name: Sex-toy cleaner
definition: product made to clean sex toys (K-11(d)).

name: Front-load washer
definition: washing machine with a horizontal drum loaded through a front door.

name: Top-load washer with agitator
definition: top-loading washing machine with a central post that moves the wash.

name: Top-load washer with impeller (pulsator)
definition: top-loading washing machine with a low disc or cone at the bottom of the drum that moves the wash.

name: Twin-tub (2槽式)
definition: washing machine with separate tubs for washing and spin-drying (region tag JP; level provisional, C11).

name: Washer-dryer
definition: washing machine that also dries the load in the same drum.

name: Mini washer
definition: small portable washing machine for small loads.

name: Pedestal washer
definition: small washing machine built into a pedestal set under a main washer.

name: Laundry center
definition: washer and dryer stacked and built as one unit (one appliance, not a set, K-1).

name: Vented tumble dryer
definition: tumble dryer that blows moist air out through a duct.

name: Ventless tumble dryer
definition: tumble dryer that removes moisture from the air without a duct, by condenser or heat pump.

name: Spin dryer
definition: machine that removes water from laundry by spinning it at high speed, without heat.

name: Bathroom clothes-drying unit
definition: unit installed in a bathroom ceiling or wall made to dry laundry, even when it also ventilates (region tag JP; K-185; level provisional, C11).

name: Bedding dryer (futon dryer)
definition: appliance that blows warm air into a bag or mat to dry and warm bedding (region tag JP; level provisional, C11).

name: Steam iron
definition: hand iron with a built-in water tank that steams through its soleplate.

name: Steam generator iron (steam station)
definition: iron connected by a hose to a separate base that boils water and supplies steam under pressure.

name: Garment steamer
definition: appliance that removes creases from hanging clothes with a jet of steam.

name: Ironing board
definition: folding padded board on which clothes are ironed.

name: Clothes airer
definition: rack or line on which washing is hung to dry, heated or not.

name: Clothes peg
definition: clip that holds washing on a line or airer.

name: Laundry basket
definition: basket, hamper or bag made to hold or carry washing (K-10).

name: Detergent powder
definition: laundry detergent in powder form.

name: Detergent liquid
definition: laundry detergent in liquid or gel form.

name: Detergent capsule (pod)
definition: pre-dosed laundry detergent in a dissolving film pouch.

name: Fabric conditioner
definition: product added to the rinse to soften and scent fabrics.

name: Stain remover
definition: product made to remove stains from textiles before or during washing.

name: Fabric freshener
definition: spray made to remove odours from fabrics (boundary 16).

name: Scent booster
definition: beads or liquid added to the wash to add scent to laundry.

name: Washing-machine cleaner
definition: product made to clean the inside of a washing machine.

name: Lint remover
definition: roller, brush or powered shaver that removes lint, fluff and pilling from fabric.

name: Textile waterproofing and care spray
definition: spray made to waterproof or protect textiles (K-11(c)).

name: Washboard
definition: ridged board on which clothes are scrubbed by hand.

name: Wash copper
definition: large vessel in which laundry is boiled.

name: Carpet beater
definition: hand tool used to beat dust out of carpets and rugs.

name: Washing-up liquid
definition: liquid detergent for washing dishes by hand.

name: Dishwasher tablet
definition: pre-dosed detergent tablet for a dishwasher.

name: Dishwasher rinse aid
definition: liquid added to a dishwasher to help water run off and dishes dry.

name: Dishwasher salt
definition: salt that regenerates a dishwasher's built-in water softener (K-11(a)).

name: Kitchen bin
definition: lidded bin made for household waste in the kitchen.

name: Wheelie bin (outdoor bin)
definition: large wheeled bin kept outdoors for collection.

name: Waste-paper basket
definition: small open bin for paper and dry waste.

name: Food-waste caddy
definition: small lidded bin made to collect food waste for composting or collection.

name: Bin liner (bin bag)
definition: plastic or paper bag made to line a bin and hold waste.

name: Garbage disposer
definition: electric unit fitted under a sink that grinds food waste into the drain.

name: Trash compactor
definition: appliance that compresses household waste into a smaller volume.

name: Vacuum bag
definition: disposable or reusable dust bag made for a vacuum cleaner.

name: Vacuum filter
definition: filter made for a vacuum cleaner (HEPA class is an attribute).

name: Vacuum belt
definition: drive belt made for a vacuum cleaner's brush roll.

name: Vacuum battery
definition: battery pack made for a cordless or robot vacuum cleaner.

name: Nozzle and attachment
definition: floor head, brush, nozzle or tool made to fit a vacuum cleaner.

name: Lint filter
definition: filter made to catch lint in a washing machine or dryer.

name: Inlet or drain hose
definition: hose made to feed water to or drain it from a washing machine.

name: Door seal
definition: rubber seal made for a washing-machine door.

name: Dryer belt
definition: drive belt made for a tumble dryer's drum.

name: Anti-scale cartridge
definition: cartridge made to fit an iron or steam generator and remove scale from its water.

name: Water tank
definition: water tank made for an iron or steam generator.
